archetype: Archetype 2: Performance Pro (Tactical Minimalism / Creative Control Room)
design_philosophy: A mix of high-contrast modern dark mode with a 'command-center' studio feel. It contrasts the deep dark background (#121016) with ivory text (#ece6da) and vibrant, precise accents (red #ff3b30 for action, green #d9ffd0 for data/OSD terminal overlays).

mono_terminal.usage: Used for timestamps, BPM, video lengths, and technical/OSD overlays.

landing_page.alignment: Left-aligned for textual blocks, massive asymmetrical layouts

studio_app.layout_structure: Left Panel (col-span-3, tools/steps), Center Preview Canvas (col-span-6, 9:16 focus), Right Panel (col-span-3, settings/export) or Bottom Timeline (row-span-2).

buttons.primary: bg-[#ff3b30] text-[#ece6da] hover:bg-[#d32f2f] rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-bold transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,59,48,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#2A2631] text-[#ece6da] hover:border-[#ece6da] rounded-none px-6 py-3 transition-colors

cards.marketing: bg-[#1A1720] border border-[#2A2631] p-8 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-[#d9ffd0] transition-colors
cards.pricing: 3-card tiering pattern, Pro card highlighted with #ff3b30 border and subtle neon glow.
cards.studio_panels: Flat backgrounds (#1A1720), 1px solid border (#2A2631), no shadows. Tactical feel.

inputs.style: bg-[#121016] border border-[#2A2631] text-[#ece6da] focus:border-[#d9ffd0] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#d9ffd0] rounded-none

motion.hover_effects: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for marketing cards, subtle border color shift for app controls.
motion.studio: Instantaneous snap, minimal animation to preserve a 'pro tool' fast feel.

images.description: Man working in neon studio. Use with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/60) behind the main hero text to establish the 'creator studio' vibe.
Smartphone displaying vertical video with vibrant neon background. Use in the 'Export to TikTok/Reels' section.
Lighted red Studio signage. Use as a subtle decorative image or in the about/community section.

media.image_treatment: All images should have a subtle dark/grayscale filter that brightens on hover, or a strict opacity overlay to maintain the dark tactical contrast.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #ece6da on #121016 passes AAA. The #9ca3af secondary text must pass AA.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All buttons, forms, tabs, and export actions MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='studio-export-button', data-testid='pricing-subscribe-pro').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, DM Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for precise, technical iconography suitable for a Pro tool.
Structure the app into two layouts: 1) Marketing/Auth Layout (scrolling, expansive, highly padded), 2) Studio Layout (h-screen, overflow-hidden, dense control-room grid).
For the Studio UI, use a strict grid with left sidebar for track/video upload and bpm syncing, center for the 9:16 vertical video preview canvas, and right sidebar (or bottom) for timeline/export.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page for maximum creative freedom. Use Shadcn for the Studio (dropdowns, sliders, tabs).
Ensure the 'Se désabonner' (Unsubscribe) functionality and Google Login are seamlessly integrated in the Dashboard.
Implement the green OSD/terminal accent (#d9ffd0) via a monospace font specifically for the BPM counter, timestamps, and processing status messages to retain the 'camcorder' studio feel.
